data.one_liner: A simple searchable single or multiselect widget for Flutter with static and async values.
data.what_it_does: Provides a searchable selection widget that can function as a single-select or multi-select dropdown. It supports fetching and searching suggestions dynamically from a server or using static data, with customization options for tags and suggestions.
use_when: You need a tag editor or searchable multi-select dropdown.
You want to fetch selection suggestions asynchronously from a server.
You need a single or multi-select input field with customizable styling.
avoid_when: You need a standard platform-native dropdown menu without tag editing capabilities.
You do not need search or async suggestion loading.
strengths: Supports both static and asynchronous data sources.
Can be used for both single and multi-select interactions.
Fully customizable tag and suggestion builders.
weaknesses: Relies on community packages for underlying tag editing functionality.
Limited documentation outside of the basic README examples.
